ModifyDataSrc.clientToken: Ensures idempotency of the API call
ModifyDataSrc.dataSrcId: ID of the data source to be modified
ModifyDataSrc.instanceId: Unique ID of the RapidFS instance that the data source belongs to
ModifyDataSrc.bucketAK: Modify bucket credentials. Only data sources with otherAccount == true can be modified; must be provided together with bucketSK
ModifyDataSrc.bucketSK: Modify bucket credentials, using the same encryption method as when importing the data source. See [Password Encryption Transmission Specification](https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/BCC/s/ojwvynrqn#%E5%AF%86%E7%A0%81%E5%8A%A0%E5%AF%86%E4%BC%A0%E8%BE%93%E8%A7%84%E8%8C%83). Refer to the aes128_encrypt_16char_key() function in [bce-python-sdk](https://cloud.baidu.com/doc/Developer/index.html); must be provided together with bucketAK
ModifyDataSrc.keepSymlink: Whether to retain BOS soft links; retaining them reduces data source import efficiency and incremental metadata sync efficiency.
ModifyDataSrc.mountServiceBindings:
The complete set of target bindings for the data source. See data type MountServiceBinding.
When passed in (including an empty list): the list entirely overrides the data source's bindings; an empty list removes all bindings.
Modification is allowed when the data source status is RUNNING or CHANGE_FAILED; binding changes are executed asynchronously.
Bindings in BIND_FAILED / UNBIND_FAILED state can be resubmitted to retry.
ModifyDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.mountServiceId: Mount service Id. Always returned in responses; can be omitted in requests, in which case the default mount service MNTSVC-RAPIDFS_DEFAULT_ID is used.
ModifyDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.mountServiceName: Mount service name. Always returned in responses; read-only in requests, any value passed in is ignored.
ModifyDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.dataSrcId: Unique data source Id. Always returned in responses; read-only in requests, determined by the data source the request belongs to, any value passed in is ignored.
ModifyDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.dataSrcName: Data source name. Always returned in responses; read-only in requests, any value passed in is ignored.
ModifyDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.logicalMountPath:
The first-level directory name of the data source within the mount service, e.g. aa-vvd-gh. Only one level is allowed; nesting is not permitted. Must comply with POSIX filename rules: cannot be empty, cannot contain / or the null character (NUL), cannot be . or .., and must not exceed 255 bytes.
Must be unique within the same mount service; the uniqueness check covers both bound and in-progress paths.
ModifyDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.status:
Binding status. Always returned in responses; read-only in requests, any value passed in is ignored. Enum values:
BINDING (binding in progress, including waiting for data source import to complete)
BOUND (bound, accessible via the mount address)
BIND_FAILED (binding failed)
UNBINDING (unbinding in progress)
UNBIND_FAILED (unbinding failed)
ModifyDataSrc.description: Description of the data source, no more than 256 characters
ModifyDataSrc.quotaMiB: Capacity quota for the data source, indicating the maximum available capacity; cannot exceed the total cache capacity of the instance. -1 means no capacity limit is applied to the data source
